de: The State Duma and the Government should do everything to effectively implement the instructions of the President of the Russian Federation. This was stated at the plenary session on November 18 by the Chairman of the state Duma Vyacheslav Volodin.

de: The European Commission has created a new financing mechanism for Ukraine worth €45 billion, which is scheduled to be considered at an emergency EU summit on November 26-27.

de: Russian specialists with knowledge of the Chinese language are in demand, and the demand for them will continue to grow. This opinion was expressed by the Deputy Chairman of the Federation Council Committee on Science, Education and Culture Ekaterina Altabaeva “SenatInform” on November 18.

de: The State Duma at the plenary session adopted in the first reading a bill that proposes to oblige the Social Fund of Russia to transfer information about the labor activity of employees registered on the platform of the fund to the portal “Work in Russia”.

d: ЕС воздержится от включения в 22-й пакет санкций против РФ запрет на морские перевозки российской нефти, но предпримет очередную попытку запретить выдачу виз российским бойцам — участникам СВО, сообщило Bloomberg.
te: Bloomberg: the EU in the new package of sanctions wants to ban the issuance of visas to soldiers of the SBO
de: The EU will refrain from including in the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia a ban on the sea transportation of Russian oil, but will make another attempt to ban the issuance of visas to Russian soldiers participating in the SVO, Bloomberg reported.

de: The state Duma at the plenary session on November 18 adopted in the first reading a bill that prevents the attempts of companies to extract precious metals, masking this process under the geological study of the subsoil.
